31242.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Boot zanjiri: **firmware** (BIOS/UEFI, POST) -> **bootloader** (GRUB2 / systemd-boot) -> **kernel + initramfs** -> haqiqiy root FS mount va **systemd (PID 1)** -> **default.target** bo'yicha servislar -> login (getty/sshd).

**Nega bilish kerak:** Server boot bo'lmasa, birinchi savol — qaysi bosqichda to'xtadi? GRUB menyusi ko'rinmasa — firmware/bootloader; `dracut emergency shell` — initramfs; `emergency mode` — fstab/systemd. Bosqichni bilsang, tuzatish yo'li ham aniq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Firmware (BIOS/UEFI): POST, boot qurilmasini tanlash
   v
Bootloader (GRUB2): menyu, kernel + initramfs'ni RAM'ga yuklash, cmdline
   v
Kernel: hardware init, initramfs'ni vaqtinchalik root qilib ochish
   v
initramfs: drayverlar, LVM/RAID/LUKS, haqiqiy root'ni topish va mount
   v
switch_root -> /sbin/init = systemd (PID 1)
   v
sysinit.target -> basic.target -> multi-user.target (yoki graphical)
   v
sshd, getty -> login
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemd-analyze
# Startup finished in 4.1s (firmware) + 2.0s (loader) + 1.8s (kernel)
#                  + 3.2s (initrd) + 12.5s (userspace) = 23.6s
systemd-analyze blame | head        # eng sekin unit'lar
systemd-analyze critical-chain      # kim kimni kutdi
journalctl -b                       # joriy boot log
journalctl -b -1 -p err             # oldingi boot xatolari
dmesg -T | head                     # kernel xabarlari
```

**Bosqich bo'yicha belgilar:**
| Belgi | Bosqich |
|---|---|
| "No bootable device" | firmware / disk |
| `grub rescue>` | GRUB fayllari topilmadi |
| `dracut-initqueue timeout`, emergency shell | initramfs, root topilmadi |
| `You are in emergency mode` | fstab yoki systemd |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cloud VM'da ekran yo'q — serial console (`console=ttyS0`) log'ini yoq.
- `journalctl -b -1` uchun persistent journal kerak (`/var/log/journal` mavjud bo'lsin).

**Senior nuqta:** Boot muammosini tez tuzatish uchun oldindan tayyorgarlik: serial console, persistent journal, rescue image va root diskni boshqa VM'ga ulash runbook'i.

31243.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **BIOS** — eski firmware, diskning birinchi sektoridagi **MBR** (446 bayt boot kod) ni bajaradi; MBR jadvali 2 TiB va 4 primary partition bilan cheklangan. **UEFI** — zamonaviy firmware, **ESP** (FAT32 bo'lim)dagi `.efi` faylni ishga tushiradi, **GPT** jadvalini ishlatadi (128 partition, juda katta disk), **Secure Boot** bor.

**Muammo:** 4 TB disk MBR bilan bo'lingan — 2 TB'dan keyingisi ko'rinmaydi. Yoki BIOS rejimida o'rnatilgan OS'ni UEFI serverga ko'chirding — boot bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
BIOS:  POST -> disk sektor 0 (MBR) -> 446 bayt kod -> GRUB stage 1.5/2 -> kernel
UEFI:  POST -> NVRAM boot entry -> ESP:/EFI/ubuntu/shimx64.efi -> grubx64.efi -> kernel
```

**Taqqoslash:**
| | BIOS + MBR | UEFI + GPT |
|---|---|---|
| Boot kodi | MBR 446 bayt | ESP'dagi `.efi` fayl |
| Disk limit | 2 TiB | ~9.4 ZB |
| Partition | 4 primary (yoki extended) | 128 default |
| Zaxira jadval | yo'q | disk oxirida backup header |
| Secure Boot | yo'q | bor |
| Boot tartibi | firmware menyusi | NVRAM (`efibootmgr`) |

**Amalda:**
```bash
[ -d /sys/firmware/efi ] && echo UEFI || echo BIOS
sudo efibootmgr -v                 # boot entry'lar
lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,FSTYPE,PARTTYPENAME,MOUNTPOINT
sudo fdisk -l /dev/sda | grep 'Disklabel type'   # gpt / dos
mount | grep /boot/efi             # ESP (vfat)
```
GPT diskda BIOS boot qilish uchun 1 MiB "BIOS boot partition" kerak.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CSM (legacy) va UEFI aralash rejim — o'rnatish bir rejimda, boot boshqasida bo'ladi.
- ESP to'lib qolsa (eski kernel/fayllar) — yangilash xatosi.
- `efibootmgr` entry'si o'chib ketsa — `grub-install` yoki fallback `EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI`.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi serverlar — faqat UEFI + GPT (Secure Boot va TPM measured boot uchun asos). Cloud image'larni ikkala rejim uchun (hybrid) qurish migratsiyani osonlashtiradi.

31244.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GRUB2 — Linux'ning asosiy bootloader'i. Asosiy sozlama **`/etc/default/grub`**, generator skriptlar **`/etc/grub.d/`**, natija **`grub.cfg`** (`/boot/grub/` yoki `/boot/grub2/`) — u **generatsiya qilinadi**, qo'lda tahrirlanmaydi. O'zgarishdan keyin `update-grub` (Debian) yoki `grub2-mkconfig` (RHEL), RHEL'da kernel parametrlari uchun `grubby` ham bor.

**Muammo:** `grub.cfg`ni qo'lda tahrirlading — keyingi kernel yangilanishida o'zgarish yo'qoldi. Yoki parametr qo'shding, lekin generatsiya qilmading — hech narsa o'zgarmadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/etc/default/grub  +  /etc/grub.d/10_linux, 30_os-prober, 40_custom
            \             /
        update-grub / grub2-mkconfig
                   v
           /boot/grub/grub.cfg   (GRUB boot'da o'qiydi)
```

**Muhim o'zgaruvchilar:**
| Kalit | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `GRUB_DEFAULT` | qaysi entry default (`0`, `saved`, nom) |
| `GRUB_TIMEOUT` | menyu kutish (s) |
| `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX` | barcha kernel'larga parametrlar |
| `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT` | faqat oddiy (recovery emas) entry |

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudoedit /etc/default/grub
# GRUB_TIMEOUT=5
# GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty0"

sudo update-grub                                   # Debian/Ubuntu
sudo grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg        # RHEL (8/9, UEFI ham shu yo'l)

# RHEL: BLS entry'lar bilan ishlash
sudo grubby --info=ALL | grep -E 'kernel|args'
sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="console=ttyS0"
sudo grubby --set-default /boot/vmlinuz-5.14.0-427.el9.x86_64

cat /proc/cmdline    # reboot'dan keyin tekshirish
```
Bir martalik boshqa kernel: `sudo grub-reboot 2` (yoki `grub2-reboot`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RHEL 9'da UEFI'da ham `/boot/grub2/grub.cfg` — eski `/boot/efi/EFI/redhat/grub.cfg` yo'liga yozish boot'ni buzishi mumkin.
- `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX` sintaksis xatosi (qo'shtirnoq) — barcha entry'lar buziladi.
- RHEL BLS (`/boot/loader/entries/`) ishlatadi — `grub.cfg`da kernel ro'yxati ko'rinmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Kernel parametrlari fleet bo'yicha IaC orqali (Ansible `grubby` yoki image build'da) boshqarilsin; qo'lda o'zgarish — keyingi yangilanishda yo'qoladigan drift.

31245.a:
**Qisqa javob:** initramfs — kernel bilan birga yuklanadigan kichik vaqtinchalik root FS (cpio arxiv). Unda haqiqiy root'ni topish uchun kerakli **drayverlar va vositalar** (storage modullari, LVM, mdadm, cryptsetup, udev) bor. U root'ni mount qiladi va `switch_root` bilan boshqaruvni haqiqiy `/sbin/init`ga beradi.

**Muammo (tovuq-tuxum):** Kernel root FS'ni o'qish uchun NVMe/RAID/LVM drayveri kerak, lekin drayver modullari root FS ichida (`/lib/modules`). initramfs shu halqani uzadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GRUB -> vmlinuz + initramfs.img RAM'ga
kernel -> initramfs'ni / qilib ochadi -> /init (systemd yoki dracut skript)
   -> modullar (nvme, dm-mod, xfs), udev
   -> LUKS: parol/TPM so'rash -> LVM aktivlash
   -> root=UUID=... ni /sysroot ga mount
   -> switch_root /sysroot /sbin/init
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Qayta yaratish (yangi driver, LVM/LUKS o'zgarishi, fstab'dagi root o'zgarishi)
sudo update-initramfs -u -k all            # Debian/Ubuntu
sudo dracut -f --regenerate-all            # RHEL/Fedora

# Ichini ko'rish
lsinitramfs /boot/initrd.img-$(uname -r) | grep -E 'nvme|lvm'   # Debian
sudo lsinitrd /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img | grep lvm        # RHEL

# Qo'shimcha modul qo'shish (RHEL)
echo 'add_drivers+=" virtio_scsi "' | sudo tee /etc/dracut.conf.d/virtio.conf
sudo dracut -f
```

**Debug:** cmdline'ga `rd.break` (dracut, root mount'dan oldin to'xtash), `rd.debug`, `rd.shell`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Root'ni LVM yoki boshqa controller'ga ko'chirib (P2V, V2V migratsiya) initramfs'ni yangilamaslik -> `dracut-initqueue timeout`, emergency shell.
- RHEL `dracut` default "host-only" — faqat joriy hardware drayverlari; boshqa VM turiga ko'chirishdan oldin `dracut -f -N` (generic).
- `/boot` to'la -> initramfs yozilmay qoladi, keyingi boot sinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Image build pipeline'da initramfs'ni maqsadli platforma (virtio, NVMe, ENA) uchun tekshir; migratsiya runbook'ida "initramfs qayta yaratish" — majburiy qadam.

31246.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kernel command line — bootloader kernel'ga beradigan parametrlar qatori (`/proc/cmdline`). U root qurilmasini, konsolni, systemd target'ni, xavfsizlik va cgroup sozlamalarini belgilaydi. Bir martalik o'zgartirish — GRUB menyusida `e`; doimiy — `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX` yoki `grubby`.

**Nega kerak:** Boot muammosini tuzatish (rescue rejim), cloud'da serial console, cgroup v2 yoqish — hammasi cmdline orqali.

**Amalda:**
```bash
cat /proc/cmdline
# BOOT_IMAGE=/vmlinuz-6.8.0-45-generic root=UUID=3f1a... ro quiet splash
```

**Foydali parametrlar:**
| Parametr | Vazifa |
|---|---|
| `root=UUID=...`, `ro`/`rw` | root FS va mount rejimi |
| `systemd.unit=rescue.target` | rescue rejim |
| `systemd.unit=emergency.target` | minimal, fstab ishlanmaydi |
| `rd.break` | initramfs'da to'xtash (RHEL parol tiklash) |
| `init=/bin/bash` | systemd'siz shell (favqulodda) |
| `console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty0` | serial + ekran konsol (oxirgisi asosiy) |
| `systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1` | cgroup v2 (yangi distrolarda default) |
| `nomodeset` | grafik drayver muammosi |
| `crashkernel=256M` | kdump uchun xotira |
| `mitigations=off` | Spectre/Meltdown himoyasini o'chirish — faqat izolyatsiyalangan benchmark |

**Bir martalik (GRUB menyu):**
```
menyu -> entry ustida "e" -> "linux ..." qatori oxiriga parametr -> Ctrl+X
```
**Doimiy:**
```bash
sudoedit /etc/default/grub   # GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="... crashkernel=256M"
sudo update-grub             # yoki grub2-mkconfig
sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="crashkernel=256M"   # RHEL
sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --remove-args="quiet"
```
Reboot, keyin `cat /proc/cmdline` bilan tasdiqla.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `init=/bin/bash` — root `ro`, systemd yo'q; `reboot` ishlamaydi (`echo b > /proc/sysrq-trigger` yoki `exec /sbin/init`).
- Noto'g'ri `root=` — kernel panic: "VFS: Unable to mount root fs".
- `mitigations=off` productionda — xavfsizlik teshigi.

**Senior nuqta:** Fleet bo'yicha cmdline bir xilligini tekshir (`/proc/cmdline` ni inventory'ga yig'), chunki cgroup versiyasi yoki mitigations farqi g'alati, node'ga xos xatolar beradi.

31247.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Runlevel — SysV init davridagi tizim holati raqami (0-6): 0 o'chirish, 1 single-user (rescue), 2-4 multi-user variantlari, 5 grafik, 6 reboot. systemd'da ular **target**'lar bilan almashtirilgan, lekin moslik uchun `runlevelN.target` alias'lari va `runlevel` buyrug'i hali bor.

**Nega bilish kerak:** Eski hujjatlar, runbook'lar va intervyular runlevel tilida gapiradi ("server 3-runlevel'da"). systemd ekvivalentini bilish kerak.

**Jadval:**
| Runlevel | Ma'nosi | systemd target |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | o'chirish | `poweroff.target` |
| 1 (S) | single-user, rescue, network yo'q | `rescue.target` |
| 2 | multi-user, NFS'siz (Debian'da = 3-5 bir xil) | `multi-user.target` |
| 3 | multi-user + network, matn rejimi | `multi-user.target` |
| 4 | belgilanmagan (custom) | `multi-user.target` |
| 5 | 3 + grafik login | `graphical.target` |
| 6 | reboot | `reboot.target` |

**Amalda:**
```bash
runlevel            # N 5   (oldingi=N yo'q, joriy=5)
who -r              # run-level 5  2026-10-03 09:12
systemctl get-default          # graphical.target
ls -l /usr/lib/systemd/system/runlevel3.target
# runlevel3.target -> multi-user.target
```
Eski uslubda o'tish (hali ishlaydi):
```bash
sudo init 3         # = systemctl isolate multi-user.target
sudo telinit 6      # reboot
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Debian'da tarixan 2-5 bir xil edi — "runlevel 2 = network yo'q" faqat Red Hat konvensiyasi.
- `init 0` / `init 6` remote serverda — darhol o'chirish/reboot, tasdiq so'ramaydi.
- Runlevel 1'da network yo'q — SSH orqali `init 1` qilsang aloqa uziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi skript va runbook'larda target nomlarini ishlat (`multi-user.target`); runlevel — faqat tarixiy tushuncha va moslik qatlami.

31248.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **SysV init** — `/etc/inittab` va `/etc/rcN.d/` dagi `S##`/`K##` skriptlarni **ketma-ket**, raqam tartibida ishga tushiradi; bog'liqlik qo'lda. **systemd** — unit'lar (`.service`, `.socket`, `.mount`, `.target`) va `Requires=`/`Wants=`/`After=` bilan **dependency graph**, parallel start, har servis o'z cgroup'ida. Runlevel'lar systemd'da `runlevelN.target` -> `multi-user.target` kabi symlink'lar.

**Muammo (SysV):** Servis A, B'dan keyin kerak — skript nomini `S20` va `S30` qilib qo'yasan. Servis fork qilib ketsa, PID fayl noto'g'ri — `stop` ishlamaydi, zombie qoladi. Boot sekin, chunki hammasi navbat bilan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SysV:     S10network -> S20syslog -> S50db -> S80app   (ketma-ket)

systemd:  network-online.target
             /          \
        postgresql   redis        (parallel)
             \          /
              app.service (After= + Requires=)
```

| | SysV | systemd |
|---|---|---|
| Konfiguratsiya | shell skript | deklarativ unit fayl |
| Tartib | raqam | `After=/Before=` |
| Bog'liqlik | yo'q | `Requires=/Wants=/BindsTo=` |
| Start | ketma-ket | parallel, socket activation |
| Jarayon kuzatuvi | PID fayl | cgroup (hamma bolalar) |
| Restart | qo'lda / monit | `Restart=on-failure` |
| Log | fayllar | journald |

**Amalda:**
```bash
ls /etc/rc3.d/                    # SysV: S20nginx -> ../init.d/nginx
systemctl list-dependencies multi-user.target
systemctl cat nginx               # unit fayl
systemd-cgls                      # cgroup daraxti
ls -l /usr/lib/systemd/system/runlevel*.target
```
Moslik: `service nginx restart` -> `systemctl restart nginx` ga yo'naltiriladi; `/etc/init.d` skriptlari `systemd-sysv-generator` orqali unit'ga aylantiriladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `After=` bog'liqlik emas (faqat tartib); `Requires=` esa tartib bermaydi — odatda ikkalasi birga.
- `network.target` != tarmoq tayyor; kerak bo'lsa `network-online.target` + `Wants=`.
- Eski init skriptini systemd'ga ko'chirganda `Type=forking` va `PIDFile=` ni to'g'ri qo'yish.

**Senior nuqta:** systemd'ning asosiy yutug'i — cgroup orqali jarayon hayot sikli va resurs nazorati (`MemoryMax=`, `CPUQuota=`), bu konteynerlardan oldingi "mini-orchestrator".

31249.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `systemctl get-default` — joriy default target; `systemctl set-default multi-user.target` — boot'dagi default'ni o'zgartiradi (`/etc/systemd/system/default.target` symlink); `systemctl isolate <target>` — **hozir** boshqa target'ga o'tadi (eski `telinit N`).

**Muammo:** Server GUI bilan o'rnatilgan (`graphical.target`) — keraksiz xotira va attack surface. Yoki texnik ish uchun hozir servislarsiz rejimga o'tish kerak.

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl get-default
# graphical.target

sudo systemctl set-default multi-user.target
# Created symlink /etc/systemd/system/default.target -> /usr/lib/systemd/system/multi-user.target

sudo systemctl isolate multi-user.target   # hozir GUI'ni to'xtatib o'tish
sudo systemctl isolate rescue.target       # hozir rescue (network uziladi!)

systemctl list-units --type=target         # aktiv target'lar
systemctl list-dependencies multi-user.target | head
systemctl show -p AllowIsolate rescue.target
```

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
set-default:  default.target  --symlink-->  multi-user.target   (keyingi boot)
isolate X:    X va uning bog'liqliklari START
              X'ga kerak bo'lmagan hamma unit STOP
```

**Bir martalik boot:** GRUB'da `systemd.unit=multi-user.target` — default'ni o'zgartirmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `isolate` faqat `AllowIsolate=yes` bo'lgan target'larda ishlaydi.
- SSH orqali `isolate rescue.target` — sshd to'xtaydi, server bilan aloqa uziladi; out-of-band konsol bo'lsin.
- `default.target`ni qo'lda boshqa fayl bilan almashtirish — `set-default` ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Server image'lari `multi-user.target` default bilan qurilsin (Packer/kickstart'da) — GUI paketlari umuman o'rnatilmagani yaxshiroq, chunki target faqat ishga tushirishni boshqaradi, paketlarni emas.

31250.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **rescue.target** (eski runlevel 1) — `sysinit.target` bajariladi: fstab'dagi FS'lar mount, swap yoqiladi, lekin network va servislar yo'q; servis/config tuzatish uchun. **emergency.target** — eng minimal: faqat root FS (`ro`), fstab ishlanmagan; buzilgan `fstab` yoki fsck muammosi uchun.

**Muammo:** fstab'da noto'g'ri UUID -> rescue ham yiqiladi, chunki u fstab'ni mount qilishga urinadi. Shunda faqat emergency kirish imkonini beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
emergency.target:  kernel -> root (ro) -> shell        (hech narsa mount emas)
rescue.target:     kernel -> sysinit (fstab, swap, udev) -> shell
multi-user.target: ... -> basic -> network -> servislar
```

| | emergency | rescue |
|---|---|---|
| Root FS | `ro` | `rw` |
| Boshqa fstab FS | yo'q | mount |
| udev, swap | minimal / yo'q | bor |
| Network | yo'q | yo'q |
| Qachon | fstab, fsck, root FS muammo | buzilgan servis, config |

**Amalda (fstab tuzatish):**
```
GRUB -> e -> "linux" qatori oxiriga: systemd.unit=emergency.target -> Ctrl+X
```
```bash
mount -o remount,rw /
vi /etc/fstab                # xato qatorni tuzat yoki "nofail" qo'sh
findmnt --verify             # fstab'ni tekshir
systemctl daemon-reload
mount -a                     # sinab ko'r
exit                         # boot davom etadi (yoki reboot)
```
Ishlayotgan tizimdan: `systemctl rescue`, `systemctl emergency`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Root paroli qulflangan (RHEL/Ubuntu default) — rescue/emergency kirmaydi: "Cannot open access to console, the root account is locked". Unda `rd.break` yoki `init=/bin/bash`.
- emergency'da `/usr` alohida bo'lsa — buyruqlar yo'q.
- `exit` qilishdan oldin `daemon-reload`ni unutish — eski fstab ishlatiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** `findmnt --verify` ni fstab o'zgartiradigan har qanday avtomatlashtirishga qo'sh — emergency mode'ga tushishning eng ko'p sababi fstab xatosi.

31251.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GRUB'da kernel qatoriga **`rd.break`** (RHEL) yoki **`init=/bin/bash`** qo'shib boot qil, root'ni `rw` qilib remount, kerak bo'lsa `chroot`, keyin `passwd root` yoki `/etc/fstab`ni tuzat; SELinux tizimida `touch /.autorelabel`. Cloud'da konsol yo'q bo'lsa — diskni yordamchi VM'ga ulab tuzat.

**Muammo:** Root paroli yo'q yoki fstab'da yo'q disk — server emergency mode'da to'xtagan, SSH ishlamaydi.

**Amalda — RHEL (`rd.break`):**
```
GRUB menyu -> e -> "linux" qatori oxiriga: rd.break  -> Ctrl+X
```
```bash
mount -o remount,rw /sysroot
chroot /sysroot
passwd root                  # yoki: vi /etc/fstab
touch /.autorelabel          # SELinux kontekstlarini qayta belgilash
exit                         # chroot'dan
exit                         # boot davom etadi (relabel bir oz vaqt oladi)
```

**Ubuntu/Debian (`init=/bin/bash`):**
```bash
# linux qatorida "ro" ni "rw" ga, oxiriga init=/bin/bash
passwd root                  # yoki user parolini
sync
exec /sbin/init              # yoki: echo b > /proc/sysrq-trigger
```

**fstab xatosi oldini olish:**
```
UUID=...  /data   xfs  defaults,nofail,x-systemd.device-timeout=10s  0 2
server:/x /mnt/nfs nfs  defaults,_netdev,nofail  0 0
```
`nofail` — disk yo'q bo'lsa boot to'xtamaydi; `_netdev` — tarmoqdan keyin mount.

**Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure):**
```
1. Instance'ni to'xtat
2. Root volume'ni detach -> yordamchi VM'ga attach
3. mount /dev/xvdf1 /mnt/rescue; vi /mnt/rescue/etc/fstab
4. umount, detach, qaytarib attach, start
```
Yoki: serial console (EC2 Serial Console, GCP serial port), SSM/cloud-init orqali parol.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SELinux'da `/.autorelabel` unutilsa — `/etc/shadow` konteksti noto'g'ri, login ishlamaydi.
- XFS root'ni yordamchi VM'da mount: UUID to'qnashuvi -> `mount -o nouuid`.
- LUKS shifrlangan diskda kalitsiz bu usul ishlamaydi (xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan to'g'ri).

**Senior nuqta:** Fizik/konsol kirish = root. Himoya: GRUB paroli, Secure Boot, disk shifrlash (LUKS + TPM), konsol kirishini audit qilish. Va har bir fstab o'zgarishi `nofail` + `findmnt --verify` bilan.

31252.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Secure Boot — UEFI imkoniyati: firmware faqat ishonchli kalit bilan **imzolangan** bootloader'ni ishga tushiradi, har bosqich keyingisini tekshiradi. Linux'da zanjir: UEFI db (Microsoft CA) -> **shim** -> **GRUB** -> **kernel** -> **kernel modullar**. Imzosiz bo'g'in yuklanmaydi.

**Muammo:** Bootkit/rootkit bootloader yoki kernel'ni almashtirsa, OS ichidagi antivirus uni ko'rmaydi — u OS'dan oldin ishga tushadi. Secure Boot zanjirni boot boshidanoq himoya qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
UEFI firmware (db: Microsoft UEFI CA, dbx: bekor qilingan imzolar)
   v tekshiradi
shimx64.efi  (Microsoft imzolagan, ichida distro kaliti)
   v tekshiradi (distro kaliti yoki MOK)
grubx64.efi
   v tekshiradi
vmlinuz  (distro imzosi)
   v kernel lockdown + module signature tekshiruvi
nvidia.ko, zfs.ko ... (imzosiz -> rad)
```
**MOK** (Machine Owner Key) — admin o'z kalitini qo'shadi (`mokutil`).

**Amalda:**
```bash
mokutil --sb-state                     # SecureBoot enabled
cat /sys/kernel/security/lockdown      # none [integrity] confidentiality
dmesg | grep -i 'secure boot'

# DKMS/custom modulni imzolash
sudo mokutil --import /var/lib/dkms/mok.pub   # reboot'da MOK Manager'da tasdiqlash
/usr/src/linux-headers-$(uname -r)/scripts/sign-file sha256 MOK.priv MOK.der mymod.ko
modinfo mymod.ko | grep signer
```

**Measured boot (kengaytma):** har bosqich xeshi **TPM PCR**'ga yoziladi; LUKS kalitini PCR'ga bog'lash mumkin:
```bash
sudo systemd-cryptenroll --tpm2-device=auto --tpm2-pcrs=7 /dev/nvme0n1p3
```
Zanjir o'zgarsa — disk avtomatik ochilmaydi. Remote attestation bilan server "toza" boot bo'lganini isbotlaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- NVIDIA/ZFS DKMS modullari — imzolanmasa "Key was rejected by service".
- Lockdown rejimi `/dev/mem`, imzosiz kexec, ba'zi eBPF/debug vositalarini cheklaydi.
- dbx yangilanishi (BootHole kabi) eski shim'ni bloklab, boot'ni sindirishi mumkin — avval shim yangilansin.

**Senior nuqta:** Secure Boot — faqat "boot kod imzolangan" kafolati, runtime xavfsizlik emas. Kuchli model: Secure Boot + measured boot (TPM) + attestation + disk shifrlash; MOK kalitlarini boshqarish esa alohida kalit-boshqaruv jarayoni.

31253.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `systemd-analyze` umumiy vaqtni bosqichlar bo'yicha, `systemd-analyze blame` har unit vaqtini, **`systemd-analyze critical-chain`** esa haqiqiy kritik yo'lni (kim kimni kutgan) ko'rsatadi. Aybdor odatda `*-wait-online`, fstab'dagi yo'q disk yoki DNS/cloud-init timeout.

**Muammo:** Reboot 2 daqiqa. Rolling update'da 100 node x 2 daqiqa — soatlar. `blame`dagi eng uzun servis har doim ham aybdor emas — u parallel ishlagan bo'lishi mumkin.

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemd-analyze
# Startup finished in 2.1s (kernel) + 3.0s (initrd) + 1min 32s (userspace)

systemd-analyze blame | head
# 1min 30.0s systemd-networkd-wait-online.service
#      8.2s cloud-init.service
#      3.1s docker.service

systemd-analyze critical-chain
# multi-user.target @1min 32s
# `-docker.service @1min 29s +3.1s
#   `-network-online.target @1min 29s
#     `-systemd-networkd-wait-online.service @1.2s +1min 30s   <- haqiqiy aybdor

systemd-analyze critical-chain sshd.service   # aniq servis uchun
systemd-analyze plot > boot.svg               # brauzerda vaqt chizig'i
journalctl -b -p warning
```
`@` — boshlangan vaqt, `+` — unit o'zi sarflagan vaqt.

**Tipik aybdorlar va yechim:**
| Aybdor | Sabab | Yechim |
|---|---|---|
| `*-wait-online` | ishlatilmaydigan interfeys kutilyapti | `--any`, interfeysni `optional: true` (netplan) |
| fstab'dagi yo'q disk | 90 s device timeout | `nofail,x-systemd.device-timeout=10s` |
| cloud-init | metadata/DNS timeout | datasource'ni aniq belgilash |
| `fsck` | katta FS tekshiruvi | rejali bajarish |

```bash
sudo systemctl edit systemd-networkd-wait-online.service
# [Service]
# ExecStart=
# ExecStart=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-networkd-wait-online --any --timeout=20
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `wait-online`ni `mask` qilish — `network-online.target`ga tayanadigan servislar tarmoqsiz start bo'ladi.
- `blame` faqat unit vaqtini ko'rsatadi, kutishni emas.
- Firmware (POST) vaqti OS'dan tashqarida — BIOS sozlamalari.

**Senior nuqta:** Boot vaqtini fleet metrikasi sifatida kuzat (`systemd-analyze` natijasini yig'ish); auto-scaling va rolling update tezligi bevosita shunga bog'liq.

31254.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Target — unit'larni guruhlaydigan sinxronizatsiya nuqtasi (eski runlevel o'rnida). `[Install]` dagi `WantedBy=multi-user.target` — "multi-user.target ishga tushganda meni ham ishga tushir". `systemctl enable` aslida faqat **symlink yaratadi**: `/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service`. Hozir ishga tushirmaydi — buning uchun `start` yoki `enable --now`.

**Muammo:** `systemctl start myapp` qilding, reboot'dan keyin servis ishlamayapti — `enable` qilinmagan. Yoki `enable` qilding, lekin `[Install]` bo'limi yo'q — "The unit files have no installation config".

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
multi-user.target
   |-- .wants/ (katalog)
   |      nginx.service  -> /usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service  (symlink)
   |      sshd.service   -> ...
boot: multi-user.target faollashadi -> .wants ichidagi hamma unit start
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl cat nginx | sed -n '/\[Install\]/,$p'
# [Install]
# WantedBy=multi-user.target

sudo systemctl enable nginx
# Created symlink /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service -> /usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx    # enable + start
systemctl is-enabled nginx           # enabled / disabled / masked / static
systemctl is-active nginx
sudo systemctl disable nginx         # symlink o'chadi
sudo systemctl mask nginx            # -> /dev/null, umuman start bo'lmaydi
sudo systemctl unmask nginx
```

**Atamalar:**
| Buyruq/kalit | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `start` | hozir ishga tushir (boot'da emas) |
| `enable` | boot'da ishga tushir (hozir emas) |
| `mask` | hech qachon (qo'lda ham) |
| `static` | `[Install]` yo'q, boshqa unit tortadi |
| `Wants=` | yumshoq bog'liqlik (u yiqilsa ham davom) |
| `Requires=` | qattiq bog'liqlik |
| `After=` | faqat tartib, bog'liqlik emas |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Unit faylni o'zgartirib `daemon-reload` qilmaslik — eski versiya ishlaydi.
- `WantedBy=` o'zgarsa, `disable` + `enable` qayta qilish kerak (symlink eski joyda qoladi).
- `/usr/lib/systemd/system` dagi faylni tahrirlash — paket yangilanishida yo'qoladi; `systemctl edit` (drop-in) ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** O'z servislaringda `Restart=on-failure`, `After=/Wants=network-online.target`, resurs limitlari va `enable --now`ni IaC'da (Ansible `systemd` moduli) bir joyda boshqar — "enabled lekin active emas" holatini monitoringda alohida tekshir.

31255.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bosqichli rollout: **canary** (1-5% node) -> metrikalar bilan avtomatik tekshiruv -> **rolling** (drain + PDB, koordinatsiyalangan reboot) -> avtomatik **rollback** (bir martalik boot, A/B partition). Shoshilinch CVE uchun **livepatch**. Kuzatuv: serial console, kdump, boot muvaffaqiyati metrikasi. Rollback'ni inson emas, avtomatika qilishi kerak.

**Muammo:** 2000 node'ga yangi kernel. Agar u ma'lum NIC bilan boot bo'lmasa va hammasiga birdan tarqalsa — butun klaster yiqiladi, node'larga tarmoq orqali kirib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build image/kernel -> staging -> canary 1% --(24 soat, SLO ok?)--> 10% -> 50% -> 100%
                                   |
                     boot fail / regressiya -> avtomatik to'xtatish + rollback
```

**Asosiy mexanizmlar:**
1. **Bir martalik boot:** `grub-reboot <yangi>` — yangi kernel faqat bir marta; muvaffaqiyatli boot'dan keyin agent `grub-set-default` qiladi. Panic/hang bo'lsa watchdog reboot -> eski kernel.
2. **A/B partition** (Flatcar, Bottlerocket, Talos) — atomik yangilash, health check o'tmasa avtomatik qaytish.
3. **K8s koordinatsiya:** kured (`/var/run/reboot-required` ni kuzatib, lock bilan bittalab drain + reboot), PodDisruptionBudget.
4. **Livepatch** (kpatch, Canonical Livepatch) — reboot'siz kritik fix; vaqtinchalik, keyin rejali reboot.
5. **Kuzatuv:** serial console log markaziy yig'ish, `kdump` crash dump, `node_boot_time`, dmesg xato soni.

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo grub-reboot "Advanced options for Ubuntu>Ubuntu, with Linux 6.8.0-50-generic"
sudo reboot
# boot muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa:
sudo grub-set-default 0

kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
kubectl uncordon node-17
```
```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
spec:
  minAvailable: 80%
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Canary'ni barcha hardware turlari bo'yicha olmaslik — regressiya faqat bitta NIC/CPU modelida bo'ladi.
- Livepatch'ga abadiy tayanish — patch to'plami cheklangan, kernel eskiradi.
- Reboot koordinatsiyasisiz bir nechta zonadagi node'lar birdan reboot.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy savol: "muvaffaqiyatsiz boot qanday aniqlanadi va kim rollback qiladi?" Javob — health signal (node Ready, SLO) va avtomatik to'xtatish. Immutable OS + A/B bu savolni platforma darajasida hal qiladi.
